record.question: The first Indian State which has recently launched its official 'T-wallet' offering anything anywhere platform for digital payment with an additional charge for the citizens is
record.explanation: Answer B: Telangana. T-Wallet was launched as Telangana’s state government digital wallet in 2017; the official state description says it is an any-time/anywhere payment option and states no service charge. The printed phrase “with an additional charge” contradicts this. Reference: https://des.telangana.gov.in/publications/Socio_Economic_2020.pdf; https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/service/t-wallet/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
